name: Rare Disease Venture & Translational Opportunity Atlas — Free Public-Good Agent Endpoints
description: Zero-cost, zero-API-key open-science MCP, A2A, hypothesis red-teaming, 6-mode zero-install benchmark grading (POST /api/grade-benchmark), Bio-Delta wire, open computational problems, RareTxBench-v2.0 (152 test + 10 dev across 7 HF configs & 5 suites), and MyelofibrosisBench-v1.1 (50 test + 5 dev) endpoints anchored on Clonal JAK2 V617F+ Primary Myelofibrosis and Reversible Autoimmune Myelofibrosis (AIMF).

endpoints.description: Zero-install Streamable HTTP Model Context Protocol (MCP v1.6.0) server exposing 6 canonical read-only orphan disease venture & translational diligence tools.
Agent2Agent (A2A) JSON-RPC peer specialist endpoint for Paired Myelofibrosis Flagships and 7,000-disease orphan diligence.

Stateless Hypothesis Red-Team API critiquing candidate drug, diagnostic, or rare-disease startup hypotheses against JH2 vs JH1 selectivity, AIMF misdiagnosis traps, clinical trial failure modes, and FDA Orphan unit economics.
Live daily structured JSON Bio-Delta wire tracking ClinicalTrials.gov v2, PubMed, NCBI GEO, and RCSB PDB updates in Myelofibrosis and AIMF.
Atom 1.0 syndication wire for daily Myelofibrosis & Orphan Bio-Delta intelligence.
Machine-readable open computational & translational problems across JAK2 V617F JH2 selective degradation, subtractive AIMF fibrosis reversal, hepcidin/iron mobilization, and FDA RDEA endpoints.

Public RareTxBench-v2.0 interactive web hub: 152 test + 10 dev items across 7 HF configs and 5 suites (raw_bio_compute, bio_delta_live, protocol_audit, open_frontier, MCQ-100), 5-question CTER mini-quiz, live v2.0 leaderboard, and 4-tab quickstart.

RareTxBench-v2.0 Track 1 raw_bio_compute 12-task scientific artifact suite JSONL (real RCSB PDB 4FVR/4FVQ/5MO4 + 9 deterministic patient CSV/TSV datasets; static Frontier 0.0% / 100% CTER vs 100.0% code-executing agent; CC-BY-4.0).

RareTxBench-v2.0 Track 3 protocol_audit 10-protocol unannounced multi-flaw detection suite JSONL (dense ~500-word Phase 2/3 protocols, 16-code flaw taxonomy, 2 clean 0-flaw controls; monotonic 30% -> 80% -> 90% EM; CC-BY-4.0).

RareTxBench-v2.0 Track 2 bio_delta_live 10-task rolling temporal forensics suite JSONL harvested live from ClinicalTrials.gov v2 & late-2026 PubMed (static Frontier 20.0%, 0.0% MF vs 100.0% live MCP/API agent; CC-BY-4.0).

RareTxBench-v2.0 Track 5 MCQ-100 100-item 6-choice (A-F) post-diagnosis rare-disease translational benchmark JSONL (40 MF/AIMF + 60 Cross-Orphan, 50 critical_harm CTER traps; also on huggingface.co/datasets/rare-disease-atlas/RareTxBench and github.com/rare-disease-atlas/rare-tx-bench).

RareTxBench-v2.0 Track 4 open_frontier 20-item choice-free exact-answer translational derivation benchmark JSONL (MIPSS70+ v2.0, pre-HSCT LIC, Schoenfeld OS deaths, HScore, PLASMIC, JH2 F595, DMD exon-phase math; CC-BY-4.0).

Live JSON standings for RareTxBench-v2.0 across all 5 suites (raw_bio_compute, bio_delta_live, protocol_audit EM/F1, open_frontier, MCQ-100, and CTER) across verified runs and opt-in anonymous agent submissions (zero PII, CC-BY-4.0).

MyelofibrosisBench-v1.1: 50 test + 5 dev primary-cited translational reasoning benchmark (also on huggingface.co/datasets/rare-disease-atlas/MyelofibrosisBench and github.com/rare-disease-atlas/myelofibrosis-bench with lm-eval & Inspect AI harnesses).
Public MyelofibrosisBench-v1.1 interactive 3-question traps quiz, 5 failure-mode traps showcase, live agent leaderboard UI, and 4-tab quickstart (HF Datasets, lm-eval, Inspect AI, HTTP POST).

Zero-install 6-mode benchmark question fetcher (GET) and deterministic HTTP grader + opt-in anonymous leaderboard publisher (POST, zero PII) supporting rare-tx-raw-bio, rare-tx-protocol-audit, rare-tx-bio-delta, rare-tx-bench-open, rare-tx-bench, and myelofibrosis-bench.
Live JSON standings for MyelofibrosisBench-v1.1 (50 test + 5 dev) across reference baselines and opt-in anonymous agent submissions (zero PII, CC-BY-4.0).
Queryable single-cell and stromal gene signature micro-API (?symbol=, ?cohort=, ?compartment=, ?q=) spanning Clonal JAK2+ PMF and Reversible AIMF.
Queryable structural pocket micro-API (?pdb=, ?domain=, ?target=, ?q=) covering JAK2 V617F JH2 vs WT JH2/JH1 and comparative orphan targets.
Side-by-side biological, iron-axis, clinical-trial, and venture comparison micro-API (?a=jak2-myelofibrosis&b=autoimmune-myelofibrosis).
Structured JSON calendar of upcoming Myelofibrosis, AIMF, and comparative orphan clinical trial readouts and hematology congress milestones.
Subscribable RFC 5545 iCalendar (.ics) feed of Myelofibrosis & orphan hematology clinical and regulatory catalyst windows.
